blocks.en: Commentary: Regulatory Documents at a Glance

blocks.zh: 為何需要多個法規依據？
blocks.en: Why are multiple regulatory sources needed?

blocks.zh: TR29 引用的法規文件橫跨六個管轄區域。原因在於清潔驗證屬於 cGMP 底層要求，各主要藥品監管機構均有自己的詮釋與要求，企業必須同時符合所有上市地區的規定。
blocks.en: The regulatory documents cited in TR29 span six jurisdictions. The reason is that cleaning validation is a basic cGMP requirement, and each major drug regulatory authority has its own interpretation and requirements, so a company must comply with the rules of all the regions where it markets products.

blocks.zh: TR29 vs. TR49 — 互補關係
blocks.en: TR29 vs. TR49: complementary documents

blocks.zh: TR29（本文件，2012）：聚焦小分子化學藥品製程的清潔驗證，包含殘留限度計算（ARL/MACO）、取樣方法及目視清潔標準。
blocks.en: TR29 (this document, 2012): focuses on cleaning validation for small-molecule chemical drug processes, including residue limit calculation (ARL/MACO), sampling methods and visual cleanliness criteria.

blocks.zh: TR49（PDA, 2010）：針對生物科技產品（蛋白質、抗體、病毒載體等）的清潔驗證，處理蛋白質降解、活性物質失活等生物特有挑戰。
blocks.en: TR49 (PDA, 2010): addresses cleaning validation for biotechnology products (proteins, antibodies, viral vectors, etc.) and deals with challenges specific to biologics such as protein degradation and loss of activity of the active substance.

blocks.zh: 記憶口訣：TR29 = 化學藥、TR49 = 生物藥。
blocks.en: Memory aid: TR29 = chemical drugs, TR49 = biologics.

blocks.zh: FDA 1993 清潔查核指南的歷史意義
blocks.en: The historical significance of the FDA 1993 cleaning inspection guide

blocks.zh: 1993 年 FDA 發布的《Guide to Inspections of Validation of Cleaning Processes》是業界第一份正式的清潔驗證查核指引，確立了「目視清潔 + 殘留分析」的雙重驗收準則，以及「最難清潔產品」（worst-case）概念。即使歷時三十年，該文件仍是查核官進廠時的核心參考。
blocks.en: The "Guide to Inspections of Validation of Cleaning Processes" issued by FDA in 1993 was the industry's first formal inspection guide for cleaning validation. It established the dual acceptance criteria of "visually clean + residue analysis" and the "hardest-to-clean product" (worst-case) concept. Even three decades later, it remains a core reference for inspectors on site.

blocks.zh: 比喻：法規文件如同建築法規體系
blocks.en: Analogy: regulatory documents are like a building code system

blocks.zh: FDA 21 CFR 211 是建築物的「土地使用法規」（強制），ICH Q9 是「設計規範」（引導），TR29 是「施工手冊」（最佳實務），Health Canada Guide-0028 是「加拿大地區附加規定」。缺少任何一層，建物都有被拒絕核可的風險。
blocks.en: FDA 21 CFR 211 is the "land use regulation" for the building (mandatory), ICH Q9 is the "design code" (guiding), TR29 is the "construction manual" (best practice), and Health Canada Guide-0028 is the "additional Canadian local rules". If any layer is missing, the building risks being refused approval.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 | 參考文獻分析
blocks.en: Commentary: Reference Analysis

blocks.zh: 高頻引用 — 考試必知
blocks.en: Frequently cited: essential for exams

blocks.zh: Ref. 20（FDA 1993）：最常被稽核官引用的清潔驗證指南，確立目視 + 分析的雙重標準。
blocks.en: Ref. 20 (FDA 1993): the cleaning validation guide most often cited by inspectors; established the dual standard of visual + analytical.

blocks.zh: Ref. 23（Fourman & Mullen, 1993）：「10 ppm 原則」和「最低日劑量的 0.001 倍」的原始出處。
blocks.en: Ref. 23 (Fourman & Mullen, 1993): the original source of the "10 ppm criterion" and the "0.001 of the minimum daily dose" criterion.

blocks.zh: Ref. 4（ICH Q9）：清潔驗證程序中 worst-case 和風險排序的理論基礎。
blocks.en: Ref. 4 (ICH Q9): the theoretical basis for worst-case selection and risk ranking in cleaning validation programs.

blocks.zh: Ref. 12（ISPE Risk-MaPP）：以 ADE / PDE 取代傳統 1/1000 最低劑量的依據文件。
blocks.en: Ref. 12 (ISPE Risk-MaPP): the document supporting the replacement of the traditional 1/1000 minimum dose with ADE / PDE.

blocks.zh: Ref. 10（FDA 2011 製程驗證）：將清潔驗證納入三階段製程驗證架構（Stage 1–3）。
blocks.en: Ref. 10 (FDA 2011 Process Validation): places cleaning validation within the three-stage process validation framework (Stages 1-3).

blocks.zh: Fourman & Mullen (Ref. 23) — 傳統限度公式原始出處
blocks.en: Fourman & Mullen (Ref. 23): original source of the traditional limit formulas

blocks.zh: 1993 年 Fourman 和 Mullen 在 Pharm. Technology 發表的論文提出了兩個業界沿用三十年的清潔限度計算原則：
blocks.en: The 1993 paper by Fourman and Mullen in Pharm. Technology proposed two cleaning limit calculation principles that the industry has used for thirty years:

blocks.zh: 10 ppm 規則：後續批次中前一產品的殘留量不得超過 10 ppm。
blocks.en: 10 ppm criterion: the residue of the previous product in the subsequent batch must not exceed 10 ppm.

blocks.zh: 1/1000 最低日劑量：殘留量不得超過最低治療劑量的 0.1%。
blocks.en: 1/1000 of the minimum daily dose: the residue must not exceed 0.1% of the minimum therapeutic dose.

blocks.zh: 這兩項原則雖然實用，但現代監管越來越傾向以 科學化 ADE/PDE 替代（見 Risk-MaPP Ref. 12）。
blocks.en: Although these two principles are practical, modern regulation increasingly favors replacing them with science-based ADE/PDE (see Risk-MaPP, Ref. 12).

blocks.zh: 比喻：45 篇參考文獻是清潔驗證的「學術家譜」
blocks.en: Analogy: the 45 references are the "academic family tree" of cleaning validation

blocks.zh: TR29 的參考文獻如同族譜：FDA 1993 是「祖父」，ICH Q9 是「教父」，Fourman & Mullen 是「奠基者」，Risk-MaPP 是「改革者」。讀完這 45 篇文獻，等於閱讀了整個清潔驗證領域的演進史。
blocks.en: The TR29 references are like a family tree: FDA 1993 is the "grandfather", ICH Q9 is the "godfather", Fourman & Mullen are the "founders", and Risk-MaPP is the "reformer". Reading all 45 references is like reading the whole evolutionary history of the cleaning validation field.

blocks.zh: Ref. 35 — 指尖單位（Fingertip Unit）的意外用途
blocks.en: Ref. 35: an unexpected use of the fingertip unit

blocks.zh: Long & Finlay (1991) 原本研究皮膚科局部用藥劑量，TR29 引用此文是因為「指尖面積」（約 2 cm²）常被作為擦拭取樣面積（25 cm²）的皮膚暴露計算依據，連接毒理學推算至取樣設計。這是跨領域引用的典型範例。
blocks.en: Long & Finlay (1991) originally studied dosing of topical dermatological drugs. TR29 cites it because the "fingertip" area (about 2 cm²) is often used as the basis for calculating skin exposure for the swab sampling area (25 cm²), linking toxicological extrapolation to sampling design. This is a typical example of a cross-disciplinary citation.

blocks.zh: 中文解說 | 延伸閱讀解析
blocks.en: Commentary: Suggested Readings

blocks.zh: 延伸閱讀的三個層次
blocks.en: Three levels of suggested reading

blocks.zh: TR29 的「建議閱讀」清單分為三類：
blocks.en: The "Suggested Readings" list in TR29 falls into three categories:

blocks.zh: 技術標準（ASME/ASTM）：設備設計、PAT 術語、連續品質確認。
blocks.en: Technical standards (ASME/ASTM): equipment design, PAT terminology, continued process verification.

blocks.zh: 實務書籍：LeBlanc 系列、Bismuth & Neumann、PDA 編輯卷冊。
blocks.en: Practical books: the LeBlanc series, Bismuth & Neumann, and PDA edited volumes.

blocks.zh: 調查與學術論文：PDA 成員實務調查數據、SFSTP 法國驗證委員會報告。
blocks.en: Surveys and academic papers: PDA member practice survey data and the SFSTP (French validation committee) report.

blocks.zh: LeBlanc 調查系列 — 行業基準數據來源
blocks.en: The LeBlanc survey series: a source of industry benchmark data

blocks.zh: Daryl LeBlanc 主導的 PDA 成員調查（Refs. 17, 25, 26; Suggested Readings 8–11）是業界罕見的大規模清潔驗證實務數據集，涵蓋：
blocks.en: The PDA member surveys led by Daryl LeBlanc (Refs. 17, 25, 26; Suggested Readings 8-11) are a rare large-scale dataset of cleaning validation practice in the industry, covering:

blocks.zh: 取樣方法選擇（擦拭 vs. 淋洗）的業界分布
blocks.en: Industry distribution of sampling method choice (swab vs. rinse)

blocks.zh: 殘留限度設定的現行做法
blocks.en: Current practice for setting residue limits

blocks.zh: 分析方法選擇（HPLC、TOC、電導度）的普及率
blocks.en: Prevalence of analytical method choice (HPLC, TOC, conductivity)

blocks.zh: 這些調查數據為 TR29 的「目前業界慣例」描述提供了實證基礎。
blocks.en: These survey data provide the empirical basis for TR29's descriptions of "current industry practice".

blocks.zh: 2004 年 FDA 發布的《Pharmaceutical CGMPs for the 21st Century》報告確立了以下原則，直接影響清潔驗證的現代方法論：
blocks.en: The 2004 FDA report "Pharmaceutical CGMPs for the 21st Century" established the following principles, which directly influence the modern methodology of cleaning validation:

blocks.zh: 鼓勵採用 風險導向（risk-based）的法規策略
blocks.en: Encourage a risk-based regulatory strategy

blocks.zh: 推動 PAT 工具應用於製程監控
blocks.en: Promote the use of PAT tools for process monitoring

blocks.zh: 從「事後測試」轉向「品質內建（Quality by Design）」
blocks.en: Shift from "testing after the fact" to "quality built in (Quality by Design)"

blocks.zh: 比喻：建議閱讀是「延伸課程」
blocks.en: Analogy: suggested readings are "extended courses"

blocks.zh: 如果說 45 篇參考文獻是 TR29 的「必修課」，13.0 延伸閱讀就是「選修課」，幫助有志深入研究的從業人員建立更完整的知識地圖，特別適合撰寫 SOP 或培訓教材的人員。
blocks.en: If the 45 references are the "required courses" of TR29, then the 13.0 Suggested Readings are the "electives", helping practitioners who want to go deeper build a more complete knowledge map, especially those who write SOPs or training materials.

blocks.zh: 練習思考問題 | Practice Question
blocks.en: Practice Question

blocks.zh: 情境：您公司正在評估從傳統「1/1000 最低日劑量」限度計算方式，轉換至以 ADE/PDE 為基礎的健康暴露限度（HEL）方法。
blocks.en: Scenario: Your company is evaluating a move from the traditional "1/1000 of the minimum daily dose" limit calculation to a health-based exposure limit (HBEL) approach based on ADE/PDE.

blocks.zh: 問題：在 TR29 的參考文獻中，哪些文件直接支持這項轉換的科學和法規依據？請列出至少三個，並說明各自的角色。
blocks.en: Question: Which of the TR29 references directly support the scientific and regulatory basis for this change? List at least three and explain the role of each.

blocks.zh: 參考答案方向：
blocks.en: Suggested answer direction:

blocks.zh: Ref. 12（ISPE Risk-MaPP）：ADE 計算方法論的主要來源，提供以毒理學為基礎的限度設定框架。
blocks.en: Ref. 12 (ISPE Risk-MaPP): the main source of the ADE calculation methodology, providing a toxicology-based framework for limit setting.

blocks.zh: Refs. 13–15（Conine、Kramer、Layton）：三篇毒理學文獻確立了從短期毒性數據推算 NOEL/ADI 的轉換係數，是 ADE 計算的學術根基。
blocks.en: Refs. 13-15 (Conine, Kramer, Layton): three toxicology papers that established the conversion factors for deriving NOEL/ADI from short-term toxicity data, the academic foundation of the ADE calculation.

blocks.zh: Ref. 4（ICH Q9）：提供風險評估框架，支持「以科學為依據選擇嚴格度」的限度決策邏輯。
blocks.en: Ref. 4 (ICH Q9): provides the risk assessment framework, supporting the limit decision logic of "selecting stringency on a scientific basis".

blocks.zh: Ref. 16（EMA 基因毒性指引）：若產品含有基因毒性雜質，該指引要求更嚴格的健康基礎限度，強化了從傳統方法轉換的必要性。
blocks.en: Ref. 16 (EMA genotoxicity guideline): if a product contains genotoxic impurities, the guideline requires stricter health-based limits, reinforcing the need to move away from the traditional approach.

blocks.zh: Reference Quick-Look Table | 參考文獻速查表
blocks.en: Reference Quick-Look Table

blocks.zh: 中文解說 | 主題分類解析
blocks.en: Commentary: Analysis by Topic

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證的知識地圖
blocks.en: The knowledge map of cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 速查表揭示了 TR29 所涉及的知識廣度。清潔驗證不只是「洗乾淨」，它連結了：
blocks.en: The quick-look table shows the breadth of knowledge involved in TR29. Cleaning validation is not just "getting things clean"; it connects:

blocks.zh: 毒理學（殘留限度設定）
blocks.en: Toxicology (setting residue limits)

blocks.zh: 分析化學（方法驗證、取樣）
blocks.en: Analytical chemistry (method validation, sampling)

blocks.zh: 材料科學（設備相容性、萃取物/浸出物）
blocks.en: Materials science (equipment compatibility, extractables/leachables)

blocks.zh: 統計學（%RSD、MSA）
blocks.en: Statistics (%RSD, MSA)

blocks.zh: 法規科學（跨管轄區合規）
blocks.en: Regulatory science (multi-jurisdiction compliance)

blocks.zh: 查核最常問的主題 & 對應參考文獻
blocks.en: Topics most often asked about in inspections & the corresponding references

blocks.zh: 殘留限度設定依據 → Refs. 12, 13, 23（Risk-MaPP、Conine、Fourman）
blocks.en: Basis for residue limit setting → Refs. 12, 13, 23 (Risk-MaPP, Conine, Fourman)

blocks.zh: 取樣方法選擇 → Refs. 17, 25（PDA 調查數據）
blocks.en: Sampling method selection → Refs. 17, 25 (PDA survey data)

blocks.zh: 最難清潔選擇依據 → Refs. 4, 10, 20（ICH Q9、FDA 指引）
blocks.en: Basis for selecting the hardest-to-clean product → Refs. 4, 10, 20 (ICH Q9, FDA guidance)

blocks.zh: 分析方法驗證 → Ref. 29（ICH Q2(R1)）
blocks.en: Analytical method validation → Ref. 29 (ICH Q2(R1))

blocks.zh: 生物藥/API 差異 → Refs. 2, 18, 34（TR49、CEFIC、ICH Q7）
blocks.en: Biologics/API differences → Refs. 2, 18, 34 (TR49, CEFIC, ICH Q7)

blocks.zh: EU Annex 15 (2001)：歐盟 GMP 附錄，涵蓋資格確認 (Q) 和驗證 (V) 的整體框架，適用於銷往歐盟市場的藥品生產商。
blocks.en: EU Annex 15 (2001): the EU GMP annex covering the overall framework of qualification (Q) and validation (V), applicable to drug manufacturers selling into the EU market.

blocks.zh: WHO TRS 937 (2006)：WHO 技術報告系列，功能類似 Annex 15，為發展中國家市場（PIC/S 非成員國）的 GMP 基準，也是許多仿製藥申請的國際標準。
blocks.en: WHO TRS 937 (2006): the WHO Technical Report Series, similar in function to Annex 15, serving as the GMP benchmark for developing-country markets (non-PIC/S members) and an international standard for many generic drug applications.

blocks.zh: 兩者差異：Annex 15 對歐盟市場有法規約束力；TRS 937 屬建議性指引但廣被認可。
blocks.en: Difference between the two: Annex 15 is legally binding for the EU market; TRS 937 is advisory guidance but widely recognized.

blocks.zh: ANVISA RDC No. 17 (Ref. 40) — 巴西市場提醒
blocks.en: ANVISA RDC No. 17 (Ref. 40): a reminder for the Brazilian market

blocks.zh: ANVISA 是巴西國家衛生監督局。RDC 17 規範巴西藥品 GMP，為欲進入南美市場的 CDMO 必須納入合規考量的法規文件。TR29 引用此文件反映了其國際化視角。
blocks.en: ANVISA is Brazil's national health regulatory agency. RDC 17 governs drug GMP in Brazil and is a regulatory document that a CDMO wishing to enter the South American market must factor into compliance. TR29's citation of it reflects its international perspective.
